chunks: Cursed were the disbelievers among the Children of Israel by David and Jesus, son of Mary, because they rebelled and transgressed.
ai.seo_question: Who were cursed by David and Jesus according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the prophetic authority of Dawud and Isa (AS) to declare divine curse upon the specific sects of Bani Israel who transgressed moral and legal boundaries. The phrase 'on the tongue of' emphasizes that their cursing was a direct, inspired declaration of God's will rather than mere human opinion, serving as a warning for the Ummah to avoid similar arrogance and deviation.
